evidence: Perplexity run 2026-10-21: 8 non-brand queries, 2 brand queries

why_it_matters: Families searching for treatment increasingly ask an AI assistant which centers to call, and they phone the names it gives and the sites it links. A center that is not named or cited in those answers never gets the call; the directories cited instead route callers to paid listings and competitors.
fix: Publish answer-ready pages that answer the absent queries in the first two or three sentences (levels of care, insurance, cost, length of stay, location); add Organization/MedicalOrganization entity schema with sameAs links to every directory profile; claim and complete listings on the directories AI cites (freemanrecoverycenter.com, psychologytoday.com, apex.rehab); publish an outcomes page (accreditation, completion and alumni follow-up data) that answers can quote.
check_first: GSC Performance filtered to brand queries (16-month impressions/clicks trend) to see whether AI exposure is already moving branded demand, and add a 'How did you hear about us?' tag in call tracking with an 'AI assistant (ChatGPT/Perplexity)' option so AI-sourced calls are counted before and after the fix.

title: Top referring domains are dominated by rehab directories and lead-gen listing sites
evidence: Of the top 100 referring domains (of 715): 6 (6%) have spam score >= 30; 39 (39%) look like rehab directories/listing sites, carrying 68% of those backlinks
DataForSEO target spam score 41 (backlinks spam score 13)

6 of the top 10 referrers by link count are rehab/directory domains: addictiontreatments101.com (1,375, spam 10), rehabconnectusa.com (101, spam 0), alcoholrehabus.org (98, spam 0), oppalerts.com (88, spam 0), fsnhospitals.com (82, spam 3), recovery.com (71, spam 0)
Highest-spam referrers: odp.org (spam 40), andrewschilleronline.blogspot.com (spam 37), openminds.com (spam 36), global-website.pages.dev (spam 35)
why_it_matters: Directory links pass little authority and, in addiction treatment, many belong to call-routing lead-gen networks that compete for the same admissions calls; a profile built on them does not move '<city> rehab' rankings.
fix: Stop paying for directory/listing placements; keep SAMHSA FindTreatment, Joint Commission, LegitScript and insurer directories; audit the spam >= 30 domains and disavow only clear link-network patterns.

title: Link profile is shrinking: backlinks -16% and referring domains -3% over 12 months
evidence: Backlinks 3,621 -> 3,042 (-16%) and referring domains 924 -> 894 (-3%) from 2025-10-31 to 2026-09-30
Last 12 months: +334 / -309 referring domains (net +25), +1,542 / -1,423 backlinks; lost outpaced new in 6 of 12 months
Broken backlinks: 13 links point at 36 dead URLs on cumberlandheights.org
why_it_matters: A steady net loss of linking sites erodes the authority behind program and location pages; rankings for '<city> rehab' slip months later, after calls and admissions have already dropped.
fix: 301 every broken-backlink URL to its closest live program page; reclaim lost links (ask referrers to update moved URLs); add one earned-link source per month (partners, local press, alumni).
